<MethodEndpoint

This call writes one claim. With pageId, the entry goes on that page. Without pageId, the entry is loose and must have a scope. An entry from an agent always starts PROPOSED. An agent cannot write to a LOCKED page. On a CURATED page or a loose scope, one token can have at most 10 PROPOSED entries by default. The server refuses a repeat of a known entry unless you send supersedesId or distinct. The server checks each citation before it writes the entry.
